column4: Hi-C gap chain0020+/chain0099-. chain0099 (456 kb) placed by user-approved group edit (D13 discussion 2026-11-26: 14 of 14 q20 raw tails from chain0050's edge enter it; TTT infeasible on the 151-unitig tangle). Its other side joins chain0050 through connector chain8039 (arbitrary against chain8097). The rest of the tangle stays unplaced (25 chains, 6.16 Mb, graph contacts only chr7_h2); chr7_h2 is still 4.40 Mb shorter than chr7_h1. Option: Juicebox check of chain0099's orientation and of chain0050 (placed on low confidence, Hi-C ratio 1.32).

Hi-C gap chain0042+/chain0051-, no spanning reads. h1 0-7.57 Mb (chain0042 4.63 Mb, chain0051 3.12 Mb) barely aligns to chr4_h2 or the reference; chr4_h2 is 2.7 Mb shorter, both telomere to telomere. User: likely satellite length variation. Option: check chain0042 in Juicebox (old build: 1,144 links to chr4_h1 vs 874 to chr7_h1).

Hand-made joins (user-approved): chain0091-chain0148 (44.9 kb graph overlap), chain0148-chain0131 (overlap:40154, identical, not in the graph), chain0131-chain0057 via chain0201. Homozygous stretch: chain0148/chain0131 are identical to chain0188/chain0207 on chr4_h2; 9 raw reads run through the 44 kb around the overlap join, all MAPQ < 20 (expected for identical copies). chain0131 reads 1.66x in one window. Option: Juicebox check that both haplotypes show contact across 8.8-9.2 Mb.
Hi-C gap chain0043+/chain0080-, no spanning reads. The neighbouring chain0080/chain0193 and chain0193/chain0011 junctions are now direct graph-overlap joins (overlap:2576, overlap:3490).

Tandem array chain0053-/chain0086+. 306 raw spanners, 37 at q20, confirm adjacency; local realignment inconsistent, so left as a gap. Edge tails into the 13-chain, 0.85 Mb unplaced component (chain0224 also placed elsewhere).

Hi-C gap chain0083.g02-/chain0128+, no spanners; left-edge tails (4) go to chr5_h1 38.57 Mb (homolog). chain0143 (34.0 Mb) and chain0134 read about 2x. The other two main-run chr5_h2 gaps are closed in this build.

Two Hi-C gaps (chain0173-/chain0223- at 2.68 Mb, chain0199-/chain0119- at 3.55 Mb), no spanners, in the chr1 h1/h2 tangle of rescued and shared chains (chain0109, chain0111, chain0121 shared at D14). Arbitrary arm at 2.41 Mb (191 kb) has no raw reads to phase it. Option: Juicebox check of the region.
Hi-C gap chain0216+/chain0108-, no spanners; right-edge tails (2, MAPQ 0) go elsewhere on chr1_h2 (3.09-3.20 Mb, also placed): repeat. chain0116, chain0141, chain0204 read about 2x in places.

Hi-C gap chain0061b.g04-/chain0072+ (chain0061 broken at 705,243 at D04; chain0072 reads about 2x over 100 kb). Left-edge tails (5) go to chr2_h2 36.26-36.36 Mb, 2 also placed: the end may be shared sequence.
Hi-C gap chain0047-/chain0019+, no spanners, no tails into other sequence.
Hi-C gap chain0010-/chain0008+, no spanners. chr8 h1/h2 both carry the rearrangement against the reference (sv_calls.tsv, high).

Hi-C gap chain0081+/chain0213-. chain0213 is a de-0 copy of chain0144 (chr9_h1) whose pair sums to about 1.5-1.85x by window depth: homozygous, so the allele call stands (copy rule). chain0066, chain0144 (chr9_h1 3.5-3.65 Mb) read about 2x. Option: Juicebox check; share or leave.
